quizzes.question_text: Luna and Carter both work editing YouTube videos on the weekends. Luna made 128 dollars after 8 hours of work. Carter made 92 dollars after 4 hours of work. Who charges more per hour?=_
quizzes.question_type: Multiple Choice Question with Single Answer
solution: To find who charges more per hour, calculate each person's unit rate (dollars per hour).
Luna's rate: $\frac{128 \text{ dollars}}{8 \text{ hours}} = \frac{128 \div 8}{8 \div 8} = \frac{16 \text{ dollars}}{1 \text{ hour}} = 16$ dollars per hour
Carter's rate: $\frac{92 \text{ dollars}}{4 \text{ hours}} = \frac{92 \div 4}{4 \div 4} = \frac{23 \text{ dollars}}{1 \text{ hour}} = 23$ dollars per hour
Compare the rates: $16 < 23$. Therefore, Carter charges more per hour.
